S0839.reason: Hypotonic uterine dysfunction is characterized by weak, infrequent contractions after a period of normal labor, with no obstruction.

S0779.reason: An easement by necessity arises when land is landlocked and there was common ownership; the cousin is entitled to access across the woman's land.

S0579.reason: Destruction of the lumber reserve by forest fire does not excuse performance because the mill could obtain lumber elsewhere; impossibility is not established.
